name: SailPoint
description: SailPoint is an identity management solution that helps organizations manage employee permissions, digital identities, information security, data access, and compliance.  The Sumo Logic App for SailPoint helps you monitor the user events, actions, operations, failed authentications, successful authentications, and user activities to your applications through SailPoint. The App consists of dashboards that give you visibility into the source deletion, user events, and geo locations of authentication events.

children.name: SailPoint - Failed Authentication Events
children.description: This dashboard shows the details of failed authentications such as the geolocation, country, state, failed authentication trends, outlier, and top 10 users.
children.title: SailPoint - Failed Authentication Events

queries.queryString:
_sourceCategory=Labs/sailpoint ipAddress
| json field=_raw "created", "type", "technicalName", "status","operation","actor.name", "action", "name", "target.name", "attributes.sourceName" as created, event_type, technical_name_in_search, event_status, operation, user_name, action, event_desc, target_name, source_name
| json "org" as org 
| where org matches "{{org}}"
| where technical_name_in_search = "AUTHENTICATION_REQUEST_FAILED"
| json field=_raw "ipAddress" as client_ip
| lookup latitude, longitude, country_code, country_name, region, city, postal_code from geo://location on ip = client_ip
| where country_name matches "{{country_name}}" and city matches "{{city}}"
| count by latitude, longitude, country_code, country_name, region, city, postal_code
| sort _count
